parameters.content:
## $0 by design — same copy/paste pattern as Phase 1-2, 5-7

No Anthropic API key here either. Pauses on a form showing you the
Publishing/SEO Agent's exact system prompt (Agent #10 in
03-AGENT-PROMPTS.md) — copy it into your own Claude.ai / Claude Code
chat, then paste the JSON back.

## This is packaging only — it does NOT upload to YouTube

Per 01-ARCHITECTURE.md: "nothing uploads a new video to YouTube... this
stage is an HTTP Request node hitting the YouTube Data API's
videos.insert endpoint directly, using OAuth credentials." No YouTube
OAuth credential exists in this n8n instance and none was set up this
build — that's real custom work needing your own YouTube channel and
Google Cloud OAuth consent screen, out of scope for a $0 copy/paste
build. This phase generates title/description/tags and queues
`publish_jobs` rows (status: 'queued') so a real publish step has
something to pick up later — it does not execute a real upload.

## synthetic_media_disclosure and made_for_kids are NOT trusted from the paste

Same principle as Phase 5's copyright hard-rule: these are compliance-
relevant facts we can check ourselves, so we don't guess from an LLM
judgment call.
- `synthetic_media_disclosure` is computed directly from this video's own
  `assets` rows: true only if any asset with `type in ('ai_image',
  'ai_video')` has `status = 'approved'`. The pasted JSON's own
  `synthetic_media_disclosure`/`synthetic_media_reasoning` fields are
  still parsed and included in Format Response for visibility, but the
  stored boolean is always the computed one — if they disagree, the
  computed one wins and Format Response flags the disagreement.
- `made_for_kids` is copied straight from `channels.made_for_kids`, never
  from the paste — it's a real account-level YouTube setting, not
  something an LLM should be deciding.

## "Recent performance notes" is always the same honest placeholder

`analytics_snapshots` is empty for every channel right now (confirmed via
SQL, 2026-09-02) — no video has gone through a real YouTube publish +
analytics cycle, since publishing itself isn't wired (see above). Phase 9
(Analytics Agent) is what would eventually populate this; until then this
phase always tells Claude "No analytics history yet."

## Doesn't gate the main pipeline

Gates on `videos.qc_passed_at is not null` (same fix as Phase 6/7, see
their sticky notes) — runs in parallel with Thumbnail and Shorts, not
chained after them. Does not touch `videos.stage`.

## Before running this

1. Requires a video with `qc_passed_at` set (Phase 5 must have passed for
   this topic first).
2. Reuses the **Supabase account** credential — wire it into every HTTP
   node that hits `/rest/v1/...`.
3. Activate, open the Form Trigger's Production URL, enter the exact
   Topic Title.
4. On completion: 1 row inserted into `seo_metadata`, 1 `publish_jobs` row
   (`target: 'long_form'`, `status: 'queued'`) for the video, plus 1
   `publish_jobs` row (`target: 'short'`, `status: 'queued'`) per existing
   `shorts` row for this video, if any.
